description: Player character v1: adult woman warped off the train in torn modern travel clothes with a rope coil. Occupation-neutral; the eight PRD occupations become outfit and starting-skill variants later.

pipeline.note: survivor.glb, walk, run, attack_*, punch, roll, knockdown and mount_idle are Meshy outputs (full skinned GLB per clip). Everything listed under kevdev is a KevDev FBX retargeted onto this skeleton by tools/retarget_human.py: armature plus a one-triangle proxy skin, ~50-140 KB each.

clip_notes.attack_primary: Thrust Slash (knife). 3.0 s, trim to the strike in-engine or play at 1.5x
clip_notes.attack_heavy: Heavy Hammer Swing, overhead two-hand, 1.9 s: the wind-up is the telegraph
clip_notes.mount_idle: Chair Sit Idle, 11.4 s loop: seated riding pose
clip_notes.knockdown: Knock Down 2.5 s, holds on the ground
clip_notes.work_clips: PlayerAnim.on_gather(kind): chop for tree families, mine for rock, craft at stations, else gather. HarvestNode.gather_kind() picks by nature family role.

kevdev.tool: tools/retarget_human.py (Blender 5.2 headless, armature-local root-relative rotation deltas)

clips.gather: crafting/HumanM@Gathering01.fbx (1.0 s, bush reach; re-triggered per unit)

clips.gather_mine: crafting/HumanM@MiningOneHand01_R - Ground.fbx (0.97 s, crouched swing; rocks)
clips.craft: crafting/HumanM@HammeringGround01_R - Loop.fbx (1.0 s, kneeling hammer; station crafting)
